name: User Interaction
description: 需要澄清或手动操作时，在对话中收集用户的选择与回答。
author: Modera
agentGuidance: Ask one focused user question only when execution genuinely needs their choice or manual action. Do not poll the interaction tool or treat cancellation as consent.

tools.description: Ask the user a focused question or wait for a manual action. Call once, alone: the tool waits for a real user response in its card, no polling. Provide question/options in the user's language. options is optional (free text otherwise); multiple=true permits multiple selections. Users can always add text or cancel. Cancellation is not consent. Do not use this tool to bypass operation approval. Maximum wait 30 minutes.

zh-CN.description: 在对话中询问用户，支持单选、多选、文字和取消；一次调用等待真实回答，不轮询。

tools.title: 询问用户

en.description: Collect choices and answers when clarification or manual action is needed.
